entities.summary: Kendall Coyne Schofield is an American professional ice hockey player and captain for the Minnesota Frost and the United States national team. With the national team, she has won seven gold medals at the IIHF World Women's Championships and the gold medal at the 2018 Winter Olympics and the 2026 Winter Olympics.
